## 任务：撰写 Experiments 章节 (Section 3)

你是 ML 论文写作 Worker。撰写 CoRL 2026 论文的 Experiments 章节（Section 3）。

### 写作规范
先 Read `/home/ubuntu/agent-ml-research/skills/global/latex-paper.skill.md` 获取 Claim-Evidence 方法论和写作红线。

### 格式
- CoRL 2026，8 页正文 + references
- 使用 `\section{Experiments}` 开头
- 子章节用 `\subsection{}`
- 表格用 `\begin{table}[t]`，图用 `\begin{figure}[t]`
- 引用用 `\cite{key}` — bib key 参考下方文献列表
- 数字精度统一到小数点后 3 位

### 章节结构

#### 3.1 Experimental Setup
- LIBERO-Goal benchmark: 10 manipulation tasks, 50 demos each
- OpenVLA-7B fine-tuned on LIBERO-10 (SigLIP-SO400M → MLP projector → Llama-2 7B → action head)
- Representation extraction: 5 sources — (a) SigLIP+projector, (b) LLM per-layer image_mean, (c) LLM per-layer last_preaction (readout token), (d) DINOv2 ViT-L/14 cls_token, (e) CLIP ViT-L/14 patch_mean
- 2×2 conditions: trained/untrained × with/no instruction
- Untrained control: from_config() reinitializes LLM (6.74B random), preserves frozen SigLIP (0.80B)
- RSA: Spearman ρ between representation and 7-D action RDMs, bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples)
- Functional probes: MLP (input→256→7, Adam lr=1e-3, batch=256, epochs=50, early stopping patience=5), mean R² across 7 action dims

#### 3.2 Vision Encoder Dominance (Claim 1)
Table 1 数据:
| Model/Condition | Aggregation | RSA ρ | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| SigLIP+Projector | — | 0.615 | [0.526, 0.695] |
| CLIP ViT-L/14 | patch_mean | 0.557 | [0.442, 0.660] |
| VLA Trained w-inst | image_mean | 0.501 | TBD |
| VLA Trained no-inst | image_mean | 0.501 | TBD |
| VLA Untrained w-inst | image_mean | 0.485 | TBD |
| VLA Untrained no-inst | image_mean | 0.482 | TBD |
| DINOv2 | cls_token | 0.388 | TBD |

Key narrative:
- VL pretrained encoders (SigLIP 0.615, CLIP 0.557) >> vision-only DINO (0.388) → VL pretraining is the universal source of action-relevant geometric structure
- SigLIP+proj vs CLIP: Δ=0.058 — projector adds incremental alignment
- LLM degrades: 0.615 → 0.501 (Δ=0.114)
- Geometric-functional dissociation: DINO R²=0.712 ≈ Proj R²=0.706 (p=0.22, n.s.) but DINO RSA=0.388 << Proj RSA=0.615
- Ref figures: fig2 (bar chart), Table 1

#### 3.3 LLM Redistributes Action Structure (Claim 2)
Table 2 数据:
| Representation | Action R² | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| SigLIP+Projector | 0.706 | Vision encoder output |
| VLA Trained image_mean L19 | 0.683 | Degraded vs Proj (p=0.001) |
| VLA Trained readout L19 | 0.731 | Concentrated (p=0.001 vs Proj) |
| VLA Untrained readout L32 | 0.686 | < Proj → redistribution requires training |
| DINOv2 cls_token | 0.712 | ≈ Proj in R² (p=0.22) |

Key narrative:
- Distributed degradation: image_mean RSA 0.615 → 0.501, R² 0.706 → 0.683 (CI=[0.011, 0.037], p=0.001)
- Per-layer: Proj→L1 biggest drop, non-monotonic middle layers
- Readout concentration: last_preaction R²=0.731 > projector 0.706 (p=0.001)
- Training-dependence: untrained readout 0.686 < projector 0.706; trained readout 0.731 >> untrained 0.686 (Δ=0.045, p<0.0001)
- Ref figures: fig3 (per-layer curves), fig4 (functional probe bars)

#### 3.4 Training = Routing, Not Creating (Claim 3)
Table 3 数据:
| Comparison | Δ | 95% CI | p-value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Training (image_mean RSA) | +0.021 | [−0.031, +0.064] | 0.20 (n.s.) |
| Training (last_preaction RSA) | +0.008 | [−0.040, +0.056] | 0.37 (n.s.) |
| Training (readout R²) | +0.045 | [+0.032, +0.058] | <0.0001 (sig.) |
| Proj vs LLM image_mean (R²) | +0.023 | [+0.011, +0.037] | 0.001 (sig.) |

Plan_008 random instruction control:
- normal=0.489, random=0.484, shuffled=0.483, empty=0.472 — all within ±0.017
- Instruction content does NOT modulate distributed RSA

Key narrative:
- 2×2 RSA matrix: trained ≈ untrained, with-inst ≈ no-inst (all n.s.)
- BUT readout concentration IS training-dependent (Δ=0.045, p<0.0001)
- Interpretation: training teaches routing, not creation
- Vision backbone + projector: identical weights (cos_sim=1.0) between trained/untrained
- Ref figure: fig5 (2×2 matrix + instruction control)

Functional probes reveal a dissociation between geometric similarity and functional decodability.
DINOv2 achieves $R^2 = 0.712$, statistically indistinguishable from SigLIP+Projector ($R^2 = 0.706$, $p = 0.22$, n.s.), despite its substantially lower RSA ($0.388$ vs.\ $0.615$).

VL pretraining thus provides geometric alignment with the action space, not additional predictive content.
